careers.name: Software developer
careers.about: Builds web, mobile and backend products. Many Nepali developers work for overseas clients.

careers.name: Data analyst
careers.about: Turns data into decisions with spreadsheets, SQL and dashboards.

careers.name: Cyber security analyst
careers.about: Protects banks, telecoms and government systems.

careers.name: Digital marketer
careers.about: Runs ads, content and analytics for brands.

careers.name: Civil engineer
careers.about: Designs and supervises roads, bridges, hydropower and buildings.

careers.name: Architect
careers.about: Designs buildings and public space.

careers.name: Electrician or technician
careers.about: Installs and maintains power and building systems. Skilled trades are in high demand in Nepal and the Gulf.

careers.name: Doctor
careers.about: Diagnoses and treats patients. Specialist training is key to higher earnings.

careers.name: Nurse
careers.about: Care in hospitals, clinics and communities, with strong overseas hiring.

careers.name: Pharmacist
careers.about: Hospital, retail, industry and regulation.

careers.name: Laboratory technologist
careers.about: Runs diagnostic tests for hospitals and labs.

careers.name: Health assistant
careers.about: Primary care in local health posts, with government posts through Lok Sewa.

careers.name: Accountant
careers.about: Books, tax and reporting for every kind of business.

careers.name: Chartered accountant
careers.about: Audit, tax and advisory with high trust and high pay.

careers.name: Bank officer
careers.about: Retail, credit and operations in commercial banks.

careers.name: Entrepreneur
careers.about: Starts and runs a business. Income is uneven early and can grow without a ceiling.

careers.name: Teacher
careers.about: Community and private schools, with steady posts and a clear licence ladder.

careers.name: Lawyer
careers.about: Courts, corporates and government. A long first few years, a strong later career.

careers.name: Journalist or content creator
careers.about: Reports and creates for newsrooms and online platforms.

careers.name: Social worker or development officer
careers.about: NGOs, INGOs and local government programmes.

careers.name: Civil servant (government officer)
careers.about: Stable, pensioned service with promotion by grade. Selection is very competitive.

careers.name: Hospitality professional
careers.about: Hotels, resorts, cruise and airlines.

careers.name: Agriculture technician or agronomist
careers.about: Farm advice, commercial farming and processing.

careers.name: Researcher or lecturer
careers.about: Universities and research institutes, often with a PhD.
